data.goal: Test whether the record's falsifiability-first screen is what starves candidate supply, and generate candidates from live primary sources instead of sealed model-prior reports

argv:
git log --format="COMMIT|%H|%s" --name-only origin/research/origin | python3 -c "
import sys,collections
buckets=collections.Counter(); commits=0; cur=None; files=set()
def flush():
    global commits,files,cur
    if cur is None: return
    commits+=1
    t=any(f.startswith(\"EXPERIMENTS/\") for f in files)
    m=any(f.startswith((\"tools/\",\"tests/\",\".github/\")) for f in files)
    d=any(f.startswith(\"docs/\") for f in files)
    if t: buckets[\"touches EXPERIMENTS (measurement of the world)\"]+=1
    if m: buckets[\"touches tools/tests/ci (the machinery)\"]+=1
    if d: buckets[\"touches docs/\"]+=1
    files=set()
for line in sys.stdin:
    line=line.rstrip()
    if line.startswith(\"COMMIT|\"):
        flush(); cur=line; commits_counter=None
    elif line.strip():
        files.add(line.strip())
flush()
print(\"total commits:\",commits)
for k,v in buckets.most_common(): print(\"%-46s %4d  %5.1f%%\"%(k,v,100.0*v/commits))
"

argv:
git log --format="COMMIT|%ad|%s" --date=short --name-only origin/research/origin | python3 -c "
import sys,collections
per_day=collections.Counter(); exp_day=collections.Counter(); cur=None; files=set()
def flush():
    if cur is None: return
    d=cur[0]; per_day[d]+=1
    if any(f.startswith(\"EXPERIMENTS/\") for f in files): exp_day[d]+=1
for line in sys.stdin:
    line=line.rstrip()
    if line.startswith(\"COMMIT|\"):
        flush(); parts=line.split(\"|\"); cur=(parts[1],parts[2]); files=set()
    elif line.strip(): files.add(line.strip())
flush()
print(\"%-12s %7s %8s %8s\"%(\"day\",\"commits\",\"EXPERIM\",\"pct\"))
for d in sorted(per_day):
    e=exp_day.get(d,0)
    print(\"%-12s %7d %8d %7.1f%%\"%(d,per_day[d],e,100.0*e/per_day[d]))
print()
print(\"EXPERIMENTS-touching commits total:\",sum(exp_day.values()))
"

import re,glob
def ids(pat, files):
    out=set()
    for f in files:
        try: t=open(f,encoding="utf-8",errors="replace").read()
        except Exception: continue
        for m in re.finditer(pat,t): out.add(m.group(0))
    return out
F=ids(r"\bF0[0-9]{2}\b", sorted(glob.glob("FAILURES*.md")))
D=ids(r"\bD0[0-9]{2}\b", sorted(glob.glob("DECISIONS*.md")))
T=ids(r"\bT-0[0-9]{3}\b", sorted(glob.glob("tasks/T-*.md")))
X=ids(r"\b0[0-9]{2}-[a-z0-9.-]+\b", sorted(glob.glob("EXPERIMENTS/*/README.md")))
print("findings defined:",len(F),sorted(F)[:3],"...",sorted(F)[-3:])
print("decisions defined:",len(D),sorted(D)[:3],"...",sorted(D)[-3:])
print("tasks:",len(T),sorted(T)[:2],"...",sorted(T)[-2:])
print("experiment dirs:",len(X),sorted(X))
